title: Minimalist chat — messages fade at the controls

steps.path: Scroll a conversation under the top buttons
steps.headline: Messages fade out as they reach the top controls, without fading the buttons.
steps.changed: The chat content stays clear until eight pixels from the top edge, then fades as it meets the buttons. The wallpaper and header stay clear.
steps.notice: Compare the first line under the top controls, then try Meadow Mist, Golden Sunbreak and Halftone Dimension.
steps.risk: The previous side is a controlled capture of this renderer with only the fade disabled and the previous top spacing restored. It is not a second running build.

steps.path: Scroll a conversation behind the chips and message box
steps.headline: Messages fade as they pass behind the bottom controls; the last message stays readable at rest.
steps.changed: The lower edge tracks the measured height of the chips, message box and status row, including a raised keyboard or queued messages. No background veil was added.
steps.notice: The chips and message box keep their colors and clarity. Scrolling content alone fades beneath them.
